name: Susanne Vincenz-Stauffacher
bio: Susanne Vincenz-Stauffacher (born 21 January 1967 in Wattwil, canton St. Gallen) is a Swiss attorney and politician of the FDP/PLR. A self-employed lawyer and notary in St. Gallen since 1993, she has served as a National Councillor for canton St. Gallen since 2019, having previously sat in the Cantonal Council of St. Gallen from 2018 to 2020. She presided over the FDP.Die Liberalen Frauen Schweiz (FDP Women Switzerland) from 2020 to 2025, during which she championed the popular initiative for individual taxation. In October 2025 she was elected co-president of the FDP.Die Liberalen alongside Benjamin Mühlemann, succeeding Thierry Burkart.
